WHEREAS, the Company desires to change the ADS-to-Share ratio from “one (1) ADS-to-one (1) Share” to “one (1) ADS-to-one-half of one (1/2) Share” on July 27, 2015, and desires to (x) amend the Deposit Agreement, the ADRs currently outstanding and the form of ADR annexed as Exhibit A to the Deposit Agreement to reflect such changes, and (y) to give notice thereof to all Holders (as defined in the Deposit Agreement) of ADSs; and
SECTION 2.02        Change of Ratio.  The definition of ADS in paragraph (1) (c) of the Deposit Agreement is hereby amended as of the Effective Date by deleting the last part of the second sentence and inserting the following in its stead:  “each ADS represents the right to receive one-half (1/2) of one Share.”
